definitions.explanation: A customer using a shop or service for the first time, as opposed to a repeat customer. Business vocabulary used in marketing and sales talk.

examples.japanese: {新規客|しんききゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of new customers is rising.

examples.japanese: {新規客|しんききゃく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧⟦クーポン→クーポン：06446_kuupon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配|くば}っている→配る：03921_kubaru⟧。
examples.english: We hand out discount coupons to new customers.

examples.japanese: {新規客|しんききゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}い→通う：01217_kayou⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
examples.english: It costs less to keep existing customers coming back than to attract new ones.

notes:
⟦{新規|しんき}→新規：06289_shinki⟧ (new, fresh) + ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧ (customer). Heard constantly in retail and service businesses, where it is contrasted with returning custom.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新規客|しんききゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{獲得|かくとく}→獲得：05624_kakutoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to win new customers
- {新規客|しんききゃく}{向|む}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦キャンペーン→キャンペーン：10809_kyanpeen⟧: a campaign aimed at new customers
- {新規客|しんききゃく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開拓|かいたく}→開拓：09954_kaitaku⟧: developing new custom

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{常連|じょうれん}→常連：06878_jouren⟧: regular customer — someone who comes repeatedly
- ⟦{既存客|きぞんきゃく}→既存客：30170_kizonkyaku⟧: existing customer — the term {新規客|しんききゃく} is usually contrasted with in business planning
